entries.5f3ebeec4528caa2: This business develops, manufactures and sells the “CoolLaser” system, which removes rust and old paint film using high-output laser light, and also carries out construction work on bridges, steel towers and other structures. Its strength is that, unlike blasting methods, it produces no industrial waste such as abrasive materials. Revenue consists of sales of equipment sold for around ¥100 million, sales of consumables such as protective lenses, maintenance revenue from maintenance contracts, and construction revenue, mainly from trial construction work. The company wants the CoolLaser method to be used not only by itself but also by infrastructure owners and construction companies nationwide; it does not actively grow construction revenue and aims to grow through equipment sales and recurring revenue, such as maintenance contracts and consumables sales after equipment is delivered. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥1,350 million (up 219.3% year on year) and segment profit was ¥249 million (compared with a segment loss of ¥69 million in the prior-year period). The company explains that it delivered 12 units over the full year and that cases of a single company introducing multiple units and repeat orders have also emerged.

entries.771dc7ab44fafeb6: This is a business that carries out reinforcement work (SOSEI method) by spraying a special fast-curing resin onto the aging slate roofs of factories and other buildings. It is a method independently developed by the company in 2006; by March 2026, it had a cumulative record of 1.7 million m² of construction, mainly repairing factories of automobile and electrical equipment manufacturers. Beyond developing the method, the company continues “responsible construction,” in which one of its own construction managers is permanently stationed at each site and the work is carried out under the company's own responsibility. Depending on the case, the company receives orders directly from the client, or it works as a subcontractor when another construction company is the prime contractor; spraying work is outsourced to partner contractors. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥1,783 million (up 11.3% year on year) and segment profit was ¥630 million (up 10.2% year on year). Large renovation projects at domestic factories in the automotive, machinery and steel industries led to higher revenue.
